description: Search Octagon's UFC catalogue by fighter, year, release, card number, parallel or print run. Returns matching edition IDs and links for card identification before a value lookup. A query can match several editions. Does not identify uploaded photos or search other sports.

limit.description: Maximum card identities. Each includes up to eight matching versions.

query.description: Collector search terms, for example '2025 Topps Chrome Marina Rodriguez 145 gold /50'.
